name: hxcpp
description: SeiunEngine fork: official hxcpp 4.3.2 + backported GC/runtime fixes (8-byte aligned allocation, weak-key Hash ephemeron marking), zlib-ng 2.3.90, and 4.2.1 Std.parseInt semantics (Lua hex colours safe).
releasenote: Forward port of the 4.2.1-seiunengine.1 fork onto official hxcpp 4.3.2 (4.3 API).
